title: Insert Text (TextAndFormat)

scenarios.title: Insert Text applies its documented behavior
scenarios.expected: Insert Text (BtnInsertText) is invoked on the documented fixture deck and produces its documented effect on the selection or presentation, leaves no new entry in %TEMP%\oPenEfficiency\error_YYYYMMDD.log and does not leave PowerPoint or the add-in in an unstable state.

scenarios.title: Insert Text appends the exact string in real PowerPoint
scenarios.expected: In an isolated real PowerPoint host, the deployed Insert Text bounded action on a text box containing Hello appends the given string so the text reads Hello World exactly, reports execution, keeps the shape count unchanged, writes no new entry in the oPenEfficiency error log of the run day, and leaves the host stable.
